audit_scope: Read-only comparison of completed PREPARE DATA_CONTRACT with historical native TRACE; no image/model/optimizer execution

causality.field_semantics: Confirmed same: both batch_position values enumerate the image axis in the actual collated model batch.
causality.observed_cause: All reordered global positions exchange images with identical original H/W aspect ratios; official set_rectangle uses ar.argsort() without stable kind. Equal-key order differs between historical Windows native and new Linux dataset construction.
causality.not_proven: The exact low-level tie-sort difference (NumPy CPU SIMD dispatch, build/platform implementation, or other equal-key sort internals) has not been isolated; package version equality alone does not imply identical equal-key ordering.
causality.risk: 3610 cross-batch moves and 20 changed input rectangles show this cannot be dismissed as cosmetic metadata; removing batch_position assertion would allow actual frozen geometry drift.
causality.evidence_limits: Input tensors were not recomputed by this audit. Shapes are generated-plan rectangles, validated by NativeBatches.batch() before actual inference. For the first failing image, native_stage checked image/input-tensor/input_hw/original_hw/ratio_pad/batch_index equality before reaching the batch_position assertion. No inference about unexecuted batches numerical outputs.
causality.minimal_repair_recommendation: Preserve v1/failure artifacts. Create explicit versioned engineering recovery that rebuilds val batches from the pinned historical TRACE image_id/batch_index/batch_position/input_hw before transforms; preserve all strict geometry/tensor-hash/zero-delta checks and same-server N/G AP guard. Validate all 5000 metadata rows before any GPU invocation. Do not replace historical order with a new stable sort or weaken assertions; keep train selection/budget and all scientific gates unchanged.
